text:
olivia: quick readout from today's 2hr GPTQ bakeoff across Llama / Mistral / Qwen. posting highlights below, will drop full artifact link in a bit.
bakebot: results uploaded -> s3://redwood-bakes/gptq/multifam/1717604832/report.html :white_check_mark:
diego: can you paste headline numbers here? quick table would be awesome.
olivia: sure — kept it short:
- Mistral-7B GPTQ-4bit: MMLU -0.8%, HellaSwag -0.6%, MBPP pass@1 -0.4%. latency ~1.3x faster than FP16 on our 80GB nodes. KV cache behaviour OK up to 4k.
- Qwen-7B GPTQ-4bit: MMLU -1.9%, HellaSwag -2.7%, MBPP -1.8%. saw token collapse / coherence drops past seq 1024 (KV drift signal).
- LLaMA-2-7B INT8-GPTQ: MMLU -3.5%, TruthfulQA -4.2%, MBPP -3.9%. instruction-following and truthfulness hit the worst.
samir: rough numbers, nice. did you test AWQ or FP8 variants?
mei: also curious about perf variance across seeds / batch sizes.
olivia: we ran a small AWQ sweep for Mistral (per-layer tuning) — recovered ~0.4% on MMLU vs vanilla GPTQ-4bit. FP8 was flaky for Qwen on our stack (kernel mismatches), so we skipped broad FP8 runs.
https snippet:
```bash
python run_bake.py --model {MODEL} --quant gptq --bits 4 --tasks mmlu,hellaswag,truthfulqa,mbpp --seq 2048 --seed 42
```
cam: deployment question — if a product team asked for a low-cost gen model tomorrow, which do we point them at? Dedicated vs hosted?
olivia: recommendation: Mistral-GPTQ-4bit as cost-optimized default for gen+code (hosted + dedicated). Qwen is fine for retrieval-heavy or long-context tasks but needs KV regression gating for seq>1024. LLaMA-int8 only if memory constraints force it — otherwise avoid for instruction-critical workloads.
diego: we should add a quick flag in model-catalog:quant-profiles for Qwen that warns about seq>1k. I'll open a PR.
samir: I'll add a KV-cache regression test to eng-ml CI, schedule a 1hr spotcheck tomorrow at 10:30 PT. also want to try layerwise AWQ hypertune for Qwen. might recover ~1%.
mei: for the record, MBPP/code evals: Mistral ~ -0.4, Qwen ~ -1.8, LLaMA ~ -3.9. pass@1 numbers in the report.
bakebot: artifact: s3://redwood-bakes/gptq/multifam/1717604832/report.html (includes raw eval logs, per-layer deltas, and perf traces)
cam: perfect, thanks. any quick perf knobs we can flip in runtime to reduce token collapse for Qwen?
olivia: try stricter KV cache validation (checksum on serialize), disable prefix caching for now on Qwen rollout, and raise min-batch to smooth micro-batching noise.
diego: ok creating PR for catalog notes + link to report.
samir: noted, will run AWQ hypertune and post new numbers here.
olivia: thanks team — plan: 1) PR to model-catalog, 2) KV regression CI, 3) AWQ tune for Qwen. aim to ship recommendation deck to product owners by EOD Friday. :rocket:
